description: UTS #46 revision 31 ToASCII as design D5 names it (nontransitional; UseSTD3ASCIIRules, CheckHyphens, CheckBidi, CheckJoiners and VerifyDnsLength all true), then no trailing root dot (events phase A plan, decision 13), through toAsciiDomain. Accepted values were cross-checked against an independent ICU-based ToASCII; refusals name the exact UTS #46 status codes IdnaTestV2.txt would. Every line of IdnaTestV2.txt itself is derived from its pinned source by test/support/conformance-sources.ts.
